title: Delivery judgment 1: rulings
situation: Both assayers rejected the delivery cut's first judgment, mainly because install writes a status-line setting into the host's own settings as cratylus's and re-applies it; the lead asked for rulings on that, on four check strengthenings and on process points.
decision: (1) Whether the status line shows the session's agent is the operator's choice, as 0112 rules for models: install asks only when the host hides it, writes the answer as the host's own setting, never recorded as cratylus's or re-applied, kept by upgrade and uninstall, and names it as a next step when it cannot ask. (2) The checks of delivery 6 and 10 are strengthened to cover a host change at the status line and at a reference location, delivery 3's fixture gains a host that hides extension status, and the version-skew checks (visible 13 to 15 and held-out 1) use a real earlier build as the older command; each is seen red first, and held-out 1 is not burned, since only its check changes. (3) A check-writer seeing a held-out check fail against work that does not satisfy it, to freeze it, is the freeze, not a run of the case during the build; held-out delivery 2 is not exposed. (4) 0112's install clauses and (1) get examples of their own, written cold by the illustrator. (5) The ledger's lifecycle capture must not depend on the name under which a harness offers its dispatch tool; that defect, found here, is fixed in this cut, and so is reconstitution's workflow 21 failing on dev if it shares the cause; otherwise it is reported as a defect of dev.
consequences: The lead routes (1) and (5) to builders and (2) to a check-writer, then runs one whole check and judges again.
